name: Iraq
dossier:
The Iraq national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Lions of Mesopotamia, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 57 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A nation for whom simply being here is a victory, and they want much more.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Iraq will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group I and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group I. The connection between Aymen Hussein and Zidane Iqbal is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Aymen Hussein - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Iraq are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Iraq won the 2007 Asian Cup amid extraordinary adversity  -  one of sport's most moving triumphs.
Iraq boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being First World Cup since 1986.
